images.scene: Robinson raises his long musket and fires at a young kid in a sunlit forest clearing while Friday stands frozen beside him, staring in astonishment; a she-goat and another kid rest in the shade nearby.
images.alt: A man fires a musket at a goat kid in the woods while his companion watches, startled.

images.scene: Friday kneels on the forest ground and clasps Robinson around the knees, looking up pleadingly and terrified, having ripped open his waistcoat to check for a wound; Robinson stands over him holding his gun.
images.alt: A kneeling man clutches another man's knees in fear, looking up while the standing man holds a gun.

images.scene: A joint of kid meat hangs from a string on a crossbar between two upright poles, turning before an open campfire; Robinson tends the roast while Friday watches, delighted, in the shelter of the castle.
images.alt: A piece of meat roasts on a string over a fire between two poles as two men watch.

images.scene: Friday stands still and thoughtful on the shore beside the rotted, broken ruins of Robinson's old boat half-buried in the sand, gazing at it in silence while Robinson looks on.
images.alt: A man stands pensively beside the broken wreck of an old boat on a beach.

images.scene: On the grassy summit of a hill at the east of the island, Friday leaps and dances with joy, arm outstretched toward the distant blue mainland of America across a calm sea; Robinson stands a little apart watching.
images.alt: A man jumps for joy on a hilltop, pointing across the sea toward a distant coastline.

images.scene: Robinson and Friday sit together in a small dug-out canoe floating on the calm water beside the island shore, Friday gripping a paddle and steering it deftly, both looking out to sea.
images.alt: Two men sit in a small canoe on calm water near the shore, one paddling.
